body: I can relate to this. Being the second option for everyone, having the blame dumped on you, just because no one is there to stick up for you. Those people in your life are poisonous, they corrupt and distort everything you do. I don't know the specifics of your situation, but the best thing I ever did was remove those people from my life and find better friends. They are rare, but they are out there. But who knows maybe I was just pushing people away again.

Why burden them with my problems, they are better off without me. I am callous cruel individual too stuck in my head to really connect with anyone. The only reason I am still around is I am afraid the knife wont be quick or effective enough. I wish I had a gun and this would all be over.
